# Image Loop attribution

The files below are adapted from [Image Loop](https://github.com/codejunkie99/image-loop) at commit [`77a1b78`](https://github.com/codejunkie99/image-loop/commit/77a1b781b91a04f96afa6a3158d56fb8b4171870):

- `skills/image-verify/scripts/controller.py`
- `skills/image-verify/scripts/review.py`
- `skills/image-verify/references/brief.schema.json`
- `skills/image-verify/references/review.schema.json`

`review.py` adds a `--report` path for a separately produced visual review, so the decision controller can run without a Codex model call. The original copyright and MIT terms are in [LICENSE](LICENSE). This plugin does not bundle Image Loop's other skills, examples, tests, or image-generation services.
